title: Forward sweep over one block
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of a machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $j \in \mathbb{Z}$. Processing the block at coordinate $j$ whose left-neighbour flags are all false, by the forward sweep started from the control table at $j$, yields the control table at $j+1$ and the same block with the left-neighbour head flags recorded.
hypotheses_covered: configuration c of a k-work-tape machine
replaced:
Let $c$ be a configuration of a $k$-work-tape machine and $j \in \mathbb{Z}$.
Transducing the block encoding coordinate $j$ (with unrecorded left-neighbour flags) by
the forward-sweep visit rule, starting from the control table associated with $j$,
yields exactly the control table associated with $j+1$ together with the same block with
left-neighbour head flags recorded.
